scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && mkdir -p dist/dashboard dist/surf dist/trestles dist/shrine && cp dist/index.html dist/dashboard/index.html && cp dist/index.html dist/surf/index.html && cp dist/index.html dist/trestles/index.html && cp dist/index.html dist/shrine/index.html
scripts.deploy: npm run build && aws s3 sync dist/ s3://prayfororangecounty.com/ --delete --region us-west-2 && aws s3 cp dist/index.html s3://prayfororangecounty.com/index.html --cache-control 'public, max-age=0, must-revalidate' --content-type 'text/html' --region us-west-2
